text: Came to Chiang Mai from Bangkok for a short trip and found Rehab CNX Clinic by chance—turned out to be a great find! I had inflammation in my shoulder, hands, and feet, and the doctors treated me with focused and radial shockwave therapy. Felt much better after just one session, so I ended up coming every day of my trip. The doctors are truly the best—super professional and kind. Bonus: treatments are AIA OPD reimbursable (just pay first and claim via AIA+ app). Highly recommend!
I honestly like coming here. It’s quite professional with the woman doctor. They use different machines for my treatment and inform me what the differences are. I would come back again

I've been receiving physical therapy here for 3-4 months now and I feel much better. The physical therapists and doctors are kind, and they give excellent advice and explanations that are easy to understand.

After traveling abroad and walking a lot, my ankle hurt terribly upon returning to Thailand. I tried everything – compresses, ointments, massage, bandages, acupuncture – but nothing completely cured it. I endured the pain for months, to the point where I could barely walk, so I decided to see a specialist. A friend recommended REHAB CNX CLINIC, saying they had successfully treated their friend's ankle. I also checked their Facebook page and saw their slogan that they could handle even the most difficult cases. So, I decided to try it. I forgot to mention, I live in Bangkok, but the clinic is in Chiang Mai. My first impression upon arriving at the clinic was that it was spacious, clean, and the staff were polite and friendly. The doctor explained the treatment process and post-treatment care. After the treatment, I was amazed by how much lighter my ankle felt and how significantly the pain had subsided. I was very impressed with this clinic. My ankle is completely healed to this day, truly living up to their slogan that they can solve even the most difficult cases.

The doctor gave excellent advice and consultation.
The clinic is fully equipped.
They can choose what's best for each patient's case.

They focus on single-session treatments, not package deals. Shockwave therapy is charged per shot, which is a reasonable price for the treatment.

The physical therapists are very helpful and provide excellent consultation.

There's plenty of parking, so no need to worry.

The male doctor was disrespectful and condescending towards patients, warning them to be careful because they might encounter fake equipment elsewhere and receive inferior treatment. He promoted the clinic as having the lowest price per shot, but the actual treatment was very expensive. One session cost over 5,000 baht for just Fogus shockwave treatment. Compared to other clinics, similar Fogus shockwave treatments cost only around 3,000 baht per session, including an additional 30-minute electrical stimulation and heating pad treatment. It's better to seek treatment elsewhere. I posted a review on the clinic's Facebook page, but it was deleted.
